question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a grey ball, Bob has a silver ball, Claire has a white ball, Dave has a brown ball, and Eve has a purple ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Claire swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Then, Eve and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Claire swap balls. Finally, Claire and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) grey ball
(B) silver ball
(C) white ball
(D) brown ball
(E) purple ball
solution:
Ball colors in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve).
Initial: (grey, silver, white, brown, purple)
1. Dave and Claire swap: (grey, silver, brown, white, purple)
2. Bob and Claire swap: (grey, brown, silver, white, purple)
3. Eve and Alice swap: (purple, brown, silver, white, grey)
4. Dave and Claire swap: (purple, brown, white, silver, grey)
5. Claire and Dave swap: (purple, brown, silver, white, grey)
Claire has the silver ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
